messages:
maya (CS): Heads up — HelixOps renewal acceptance window is 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-08. They want the license transferred to Helix EU entity on renewal. Need signer authority + PO confirmation. Tagging @jordan @sam @elena to sync next steps.

jordan (AM): On it. Procurement said PO will be submitted, likely PO# 987654. They asked whether we can invoice the EU subsidiary vs parent.

sam (Legal): If they want entity-level contract, we'll need an org-to-org amendment. I can draft a short addendum with the effective date and transfer clause. Any EU-specific DPA changes?

maya (CS): Customer requested DPS + SOC2 mention. Legal already has standard EU addendum template — should be fine.

elena (Onboarding): If the license moves, we need a new SSO invite and to migrate the workspace metadata. Recommend scheduling enablement week of 2025-07-15 after contracts are signed.

paul (Finance): Finance needs vendor code to appear on the invoice. Ask them to include vendorcode 44321 in the PO. Also confirm net30 vs net45.

jordan (AM): Confirmed vendorcode 44321 is required. Procurement indicated net30. I'll update the quote to show VAT handling for EU billing.

sam (Legal): Drafting the amendment now. I'll include: transfer language, effective date, and a signature block for the EU entity. Will upload to DocuSign in ~2 hours.

docsend-bot: New document uploaded: https://docsend.com/view/helixops-renewal-packet (renewal packet v2)

maya (CS): Quick checklist for this thread: 1) Amendment signed via DocuSign 2) PO received with vendorcode 44321 and PO# 987654 3) Invoice issued to Helix EU entity (VAT noted) 4) Enablement scheduled + SSO invites 5) Close loop on support credit (if any).

nate (CS Lead): Account health note: usage steady, one latency incident on 6/10 resolved by infra team. Customer asked about a small goodwill credit for the incident — proposing $500. Thoughts?

jordan (AM): Proposal: 3% discount for a 9-month term extension if they sign by 2025-07-08. That softens the ask and keeps unit economics.

maya (CS): Customer also asked about prorating since renewal date is mid-cycle; recommend prorate to month boundary to keep billing aligned.

sam (Legal): I'll add an acceptance window clause to the DocuSign packet to lock the offer end date 2025-07-08 and include effective date rules for prorate.

elena (Onboarding): After signature, I'll send the enablement calendar and the training deck link. Can also include a 30-min transfer walkthrough for IT (SSO + billing contact).

jordan (AM): Procurement replied — PO will come from procurement@helixops.com and should include PO# 987654 and vendorcode 44321. I'll paste the vendor PO when it arrives.

maya (CS): Great — @sam please ping here when DocuSign is ready. @jordan update this thread with the scanned PO. I'll keep customer health notes updated. :thumbsup:

sam (Legal): DocuSign sent: https://docusign.com/transaction/ABCD1234 — sending to procurement & legal contacts now.

jordan (AM): Got the PO scan (attached in procurement thread). PO# 987654 matches. Forwarding to finance for invoicing.

paul (Finance): Received PO 987654 with vendorcode 44321. I'll queue the invoice once the signed amendment is received and set terms net30.

maya (CS): Closing notes: aim to have signed amendment + PO by 2025-07-08 to lock the renewal price and enable the transfer. Followups: @elena will schedule enablement after signature; @paul will issue invoice; @nate will prepare the $500 credit approval if we decide to grant.

jordan (AM): I'll chase procurement today and try to get signature commitment. Thanks all.

maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll update the customer success playbook with the final steps and capture feedback during enablement.
